user.title: Kamado Joe
user.description: Sign in with your Kamado Joe app account. These are the same credentials you use in the Kamado Joe mobile app; they are stored locally in Home Assistant and only sent to Kamado Joe's own cloud.

device.title: Choose your grills
device.description: Your account has more than one paired grill. Pick the ones to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Kamado Joe rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter it again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Kamado Joe cloud.
error.no_devices: That account signed in, but has no paired grills. Pair the grill in the Kamado Joe app first.

abort.reauth_successful: Reconnected to the Kamado Joe cloud.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll while at least one grill is freshly reporting as powered on.
data_description.idle_scan_interval: How often to poll after every grill has been logically off or stopped reporting for the configured grace period. Active-cook discovery can take up to this long; press Refresh data for an immediate check.
data_description.stale_after: Grace period before polling backs off when every grill is logically off or no longer reporting. The Stale data sensor itself turns on only for missing reports.
data_description.track_history: Records a downsampled series for the current cook, for charting. Turn off if you only chart from Recorder history.

get_cook_history.name: Get cook history
get_cook_history.description: Returns a cook as chartable series. Reads Home Assistant's own recorded history when it covers the cook, and falls back to Kamado Joe's cloud when it does not. Returned as a response; nothing is written to entity state.

device_id.name: Grill
device_id.description: Which grill to fetch a cook for.

session_id.name: Cook ID
session_id.description: A specific cook to fetch. Leave empty for the most recent one. Use 'List cooks' to find IDs.

max_points.name: Maximum points
max_points.description: Thin each series to at most this many points. A long cook can be several thousand samples.

source.name: Source
source.description: Auto reads locally when recorded history covers the cook and uses the cloud otherwise. Local never leaves Home Assistant. Cloud always fetches from Kamado Joe, at roughly 10-second resolution.

list_cooks.name: List cooks
list_cooks.description: Lists every cook Kamado Joe's cloud still holds, newest first, including cooks from before Home Assistant knew about the grill. Returns IDs and timings only, no sample data.

device_id.name: Grill
device_id.description: Which grill to list cooks for.
